I got mine within the last week from Amazon, and it has taken my MFLB to the next level. I had to significantly lower the power setting on my PA (1.0) to keep it from vaping too harshly, and I'm thinking about giving the batteries a chance since the vaporization is so much more effective on bud ground this fine. I've been using the same trench (granted it was topped with kief) for 3 sessions already and it is still getting me lifted.

I used to flip my grinders (Piranha + Diamond Grind) and just grind upside down, but it doesn't get anywhere near this fine. That method also caused my grinders to get grippy in between the top two pieces so it wouldn't turn easily and I'd have to clean it out with ISO.
The MFLB finishing grinder is so worth it

Im glad i didn't hesitate getting the finishing grinder before anything else. Its an absolute must, before the PA and any other accessories in my opinion. The nano grinder is a quick, "lets grind this little nug up and vape already". and the finishing grinder is a "Hey easy pal, don't press too hard. Lets shave the weed and made it a fluffy powder".
Right on. I mean, I love both the PA and the finishing grinder, but I think I would have enjoyed the MFLB on batteries much more early on if I had gotten this.
